summary: The pinned bundle hash matches. The frozen evidence supports the full-stack build, cascade query cases, manifest schema checks, and a simulated start/status/stop lifecycle. It does not cover required baud rejection or missing-UART hardware behavior, so acceptance cannot be established.
findings: The bundle and referenced diff/evidence hashes match their recorded SHA256 values; the checkout log pins the expected candidate commit.
The frozen run reports successful builds for five targets, 14/14 cascade cases, 16/16 schema cases, and a sim-mode deployment with HTTP 200 status followed by service shutdown and PID cleanup.

The required negative cases for rejecting an unsupported baud in both the serial and host-query paths, and aborting hardware mode when the configured UART is absent, were not executed. The available logs do not establish those behaviors.

No distinct recovery case is evidenced, such as a failed startup followed by a clean retry or repeated stop/start lifecycle. Software evidence also cannot establish hardware-in-the-loop UART operation.

source_report is empty, so there is no report or report hash to audit. The candidate diff was reviewed against the contract; the broad cascade negatives do not substitute for the required baud and hardware-mode negatives.
accepted_scope: Reviewed the TWIN-43 revision 1 contract and pinned soc-ap diff, along with the frozen server QA evidence. Supported evidence covers build, cascade query and schema checks, and simulated deployment status/stop behavior. Acceptance remains unverified for the explicitly required baud and hardware-mode negative behavior and recovery coverage.
unexecuted: Unsupported baud rejection in serial_open and parse_baud_rate, including refusal to open the serial device.
Hardware-mode startup with a nonexistent AISOC_UART_DEVICE and verification of explicit nonzero failure without sim fallback.
Recovery behavior after startup failure and repeated lifecycle operation.
